projects.title: AI Travel Assistant
projects.description: An AI-powered travel-planning application that helps users explore travel options based on preferences and budget. Features an AI chat experience, travel recommendation workflows (mock data), and a Paystack test payment checkout flow (sandbox mode).
challenges: Designing stateful AI chat interactions for travel planning.
Delegating API calls through an application/proxy layer to manage sensitive credentials.
Integrating Paystack sandbox test mode for payment workflow demonstration.
solutions: Structured conversational prompt workflows to keep recommendations relevant.
Decoupled UI from third-party services using an application proxy configuration.
Validated Paystack test sandbox callback handling for checkout demonstration.

projects.title: Recipe Finder Application
projects.description: An API-driven recipe discovery & cloud deployment solution demonstrating both Sales Engineering and Solutions Engineering. Features React/TypeScript, TheMealDB REST API integration, React Query caching, Context API, Docker multi-stage build, and AWS deployment workflow (Amazon ECR, Amazon EC2, Linux (Ubuntu)). Includes dual demos: Sales Engineer Demo and Solutions Engineer Demo.
challenges: Handling frequent search input and API request optimization without unnecessary network calls or component re-renders.
Containerizing the React SPA into a multi-stage Docker image with Nginx runtime for production deployment.
Navigating Linux (Ubuntu), SSH, AWS ECR image tagging/pushing, and EC2 container deployment workflows.
solutions: Implemented debounced search and memoization to minimize re-renders and network traffic.
Integrated React Query for server-state caching and Context API for client state.
Created a multi-stage Dockerfile (Node.js Alpine build -> Nginx Alpine runtime) and deployed to Amazon EC2 via ECR.
